items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: And people like Thelonious Monk, I think he must be insane and yet there’s one tune I know he plays that I think is just a gorgeous thing called “‘Round Midnight.”

ctx.x: And people like Thelonious Monk, I think he must be insane and yet there’s one tune I know he plays that I think is just a gorgeous thing called “‘Round Midnight.” You’ve heard of that?
